source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1]
    rb, cb = [-1] + sep_rows + [h], [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    excluded_rows, excluded_cols = set(sep_rows), set(sep_cols)
    colors = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in excluded_rows
              for c in range(w) if c not in excluded_cols]
    background = Counter(colors).most_common(1)[0][0]
    separator_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(rb, rb[1:]):
        row = []
        for c, d in zip(cb, cb[1:]):
            marks = sum(v != background and v not in separator_colors
                        for line in grid[a+1:b] for v in line[c+1:d])
            row.append(1 if marks > 1 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
